The '''Calant Engagement''' was a training exercise held at the [[Galactic Outdoor Survival School/Legends|Galactic Outdoor Survival School]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Thrantin]]. During the third Calant Engagement exercise, [[Stren Grier]] almost defeated [[Akul Witig]] in [[Water/Legends|aquatic]] survival.
